patch_description: Replace the random square sample with a deterministic multi-start simulated-annealing construction inside a fixed triangular convex hull. Fixing the three hull vertices makes the hull area constant, so every candidate can be evaluated directly by its normalized minimum triangle area. The search uses a smooth lower-envelope objective during annealing to avoid the severe plateaus of the raw minimum-area objective, while retaining the best configuration according to the true minimum over all 286 triangles. Simplex projection guarantees that every generated point remains within the convex triangular region, and the fixed seed ensures reproducibility.
